clone_evidence_thresholds.calibration: Gale 2020: same pool 0.89-0.99, independent pools 0.42-0.43, different strains 0.33

interpretation.same pool (shared clones): shares clones: high correlation reflects library structure, not biological similarity
interpretation.same strain, different pool: independent libraries: reproducibility of the insertion landscape
interpretation.different strain: strain differences in essentiality/accessibility, plus library noise
interpretation.different species: conservation of the insertion landscape over 1:1 orthologs
